about.heroTitle: Built by someone who's been on your side of the table
about.heroSubtitle: TermLift was built by a procurement professional — not a tech team that's never negotiated a contract.
about.whyContent: I spent years on the buying side watching the same thing happen: a vendor quote would land with a founder or a BU manager, they'd read it, nothing would jump out, and they'd sign. Meanwhile the auto-renewal clause, the 8% annual price escalation, the 15 unused seats, all just sat there costing money. TermLift is the procurement expert that should have been in the room.
about.card1Desc: Every red flag, negotiation ask, and email draft is built on real procurement experience. Not generic AI output.
about.card2Desc: You shouldn't need a VP of Procurement to get better terms. TermLift levels the playing field.
about.card3Desc: Your vendor pricing is confidential. We built TermLift with that in mind from day one — encrypted, never trained on, quote files never stored.
about.founderBio: TermLift was built by a procurement professional currently working in the industry — across vendor negotiations, SaaS contracts, agency agreements, and supplier management. Built to solve a problem seen every day: good people signing bad contracts because they didn't have the right tools.
about.value1Desc: We tell you what we actually find, not what you want to hear.
about.value2Desc: Procurement expertise shouldn't require a procurement degree.

pricingPage.foot: Try one quote without signing up. Create a free account for up to {n} Quick Analyses. Quote files are read in memory and never stored.
pricingPage.faq1q: Is the quick analysis really free?
pricingPage.faq1a: Yes. Try one quote without signing up, and create a free account for up to 4 Quick Analyses: the deal score, every red flag with its severity and why it matters, the estimated savings range and what is already solid. No card, no trial clock.
pricingPage.faq2q: What does the Negotiation Playbook cost?
pricingPage.faq2a: {price} per deal, one time. It covers the ordered asks with amounts and fallbacks, your leverage and what you can offer, the ready-to-send email with regenerations, and every later round on that deal. During early access, until {date}, it is free, and your first Playbook stays free after that.
pricingPage.faq3q: How is the negotiation service priced?
pricingPage.faq3a: Success-based: {pct}% of the savings TermLift verifies against your original quote, with a minimum of {min}. No savings, no fee. Nothing is agreed with the vendor without your approval.
pricingPage.faq4q: Do I need a credit card to start?
pricingPage.faq4a: No. Quick analyses and, during early access, the Negotiation Playbook need no payment details. The negotiation service is invoiced after the deal closes.
pricingPage.faq5q: Can I stop at any step?
pricingPage.faq5a: Yes. Every deal moves along the same ladder and you can stop wherever you like: read the quick analysis, build the Negotiation Playbook on the deals that matter, negotiate yourself, or hand one deal to TermLift. You can also delete any deal or your whole account at any time.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.summary1: Quote files are read in memory and never stored. We keep the text we extract only temporarily, and the analysis until you delete the deal.
privacyPage.summary2: Extracted quote text goes when the Negotiation Playbook is built, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload — whichever comes first.
privacyPage.summary3: Extracted text is sent to Anthropic (Claude AI) for analysis — they don't train on API data.
privacyPage.summary4: We don't sell, share, or use your data for advertising.
privacyPage.summary5: You can delete your account and all associated data anytime, including any document you asked us to keep for a negotiation.
privacyPage.s1p1: TermLift is a supplier-quote analysis and negotiation service operated by its founding team. We help businesses analyse supplier quotes and negotiate better commercial terms, using AI to surface negotiation leverage and identify risks.
privacyPage.s2Account1: Email address (for login and service communications)
privacyPage.s2Account2: Password (hashed — we never store or see your plaintext password)
privacyPage.s2Account3: How many analyses you have run
privacyPage.s2Deal1: Text extracted from your uploaded quote (kept temporarily — see Data Retention)
privacyPage.s2Deal2: AI-generated analysis output (negotiation insights, risk flags, benchmarks, email drafts)
privacyPage.s2Deal3: Deal metadata (title, vendor name, deal type, etc.), the negotiation context you enter (objective, budget, competing quotes, seats, deadlines), each round you add and the outcome you record
privacyPage.s2Payment1: We do not collect card details inside the product today
privacyPage.s2Payment2: If you use the negotiation service we keep what an invoice needs: company name, address and VAT number
privacyPage.s2Auto1: IP address, browser type, and device information
privacyPage.s2Auto2: Usage patterns and feature interaction via PostHog analytics, only if you accept analytics cookies
privacyPage.s3Item1: Provide the AI-powered deal analysis service
privacyPage.s3Item2: Manage your account and apply the free-analysis limit
privacyPage.s3Item3: Invoice the negotiation service where you have asked for it
privacyPage.s3Item4: Send service updates and important notifications (not marketing unless you opt in)
privacyPage.s3Item5: Improve the service based on aggregated usage patterns tied to your account id, never to your documents
privacyPage.s3Item6: Prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access
privacyPage.s4Intro: We only share data with the service providers necessary to run TermLift. We do not sell, rent, or share your data with advertisers, data brokers, or social media platforms.
privacyPage.s4AnthropicDesc: Extracted text from your documents is sent to Anthropic's Claude AI for analysis. Anthropic does not use API data to train their models.
privacyPage.s4SupabaseDesc: Database and authentication hosting. SOC 2 Type II certified. All data encrypted at rest and in transit.
privacyPage.s4VercelDesc: Application hosting and deployment. SOC 2 certified with enterprise-grade infrastructure.
privacyPage.s4PostHogDesc: Product analytics tied to your account id, loaded only after you accept analytics cookies. We do not send your email address, vendor names, amounts from your documents or any document content to PostHog.
privacyPage.s5Item1: Read in memory and never stored. A final document you upload when closing a deal is read the same way; we keep only its SHA-256 fingerprint, file type and the figures we read from it
privacyPage.s5Item2: Kept on the deal while the Negotiation Playbook may still need it, then removed: when the Playbook is built, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload, whichever comes first
privacyPage.s5Item3: Analysis results, structured deal facts (vendor, product, totals, term) and outcomes are kept until you delete the deal or your account
privacyPage.s5Item4: Removed 30 days after the negotiation closes, and never later than 12 months after upload
privacyPage.s5Note: We do not sell or share your data with advertisers. When you delete a deal or your account, its rows and documents are removed from our database and storage at once; our providers' own operational logs age out on their schedules, and de-identified benchmark rows remain.
privacyPage.s6Intro: We use minimal cookies, strictly for functionality and analytics. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacyPage.s6Session1: Supabase auth cookies to keep you logged in securely
privacyPage.s6Session2: These are essential for the service to function
privacyPage.s6Analytics1: PostHog cookies for product analytics tied to your account id, set only if you accept analytics cookies
privacyPage.s6Analytics2: Used to understand usage patterns and improve the service
privacyPage.s7Intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and similar data protection laws, you have the following rights:
privacyPage.s7AccessDesc: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
privacyPage.s7DeleteDesc: Request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time — this is also available directly in your profile settings
privacyPage.s7CorrectDesc: Update or correct any inaccurate personal information
privacyPage.s7ExportDesc: Receive your data in a portable, machine-readable format
privacyPage.s7ObjectDesc: Object to certain types of data processing
privacyPage.s7Contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at {email}. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacyPage.s8Text: Our database and file storage are hosted in the EU (Supabase, eu-west-1). Your data may also be processed in the United States and other countries where our service providers (Anthropic, Vercel) operate. For transfers of personal data outside the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom we rely on Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
privacyPage.s9Text: TermLift is not intended for users under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.
privacyPage.s10Text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you via email at least 14 days before the changes take effect. Continued use of TermLift after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacyPage.lead: What we collect, where it goes, and how to get it deleted. No tracking pixels, no data brokers, no surprises.
privacyPage.s3Item7: Run the negotiation on your behalf where you have asked for it. That means sharing the relevant deal details with the vendor, and only what that negotiation needs
privacyPage.s2Deal4: If you use the negotiation service: what you tell us about the deal, the supplier contact details you choose to give us (name, email, phone) and, if you attach a quote or contract, the document itself for the duration of the case (see Data Retention)
privacyPage.s3Item8: Build de-identified pricing benchmarks from the outcomes of closed negotiations: vendor, product, price, term and the month of close. A benchmark row carries no name, email, account, deal or document reference. It is pseudonymised rather than anonymous, it is reviewed by a person before it is added, and it remains after the deal or account it came from is deleted
privacyPage.s5Item5: Kept until you delete your account
privacyPage.s5Item6: IP addresses and error details are removed after 90 days; token and cost counts are kept without them
privacyPage.s5Item7: De-identified outcome rows (section 3) are kept after the deal they came from is deleted

termsPage.s3Item5: Results vary by deal — past analyses don't predict future outcomes.

termsPage.s15Intro: When you ask TermLift to negotiate a deal, the following applies in addition to the rest of these Terms.

Everything we negotiate is a proposal until you approve it. Any wider authority would need a separate written arrangement that is lawful in your jurisdiction.
termsPage.s15Scope3: You keep final approval authority. Nothing is agreed with the supplier without your explicit approval, and you sign the contract yourself.
termsPage.s15Scope4: We may decline a request, or stop a negotiation, if the deal is outside what we can realistically handle. If we stop before any outcome, no fee is due.
termsPage.s15FeeTitle: Success fee and how savings are measured
termsPage.s15Fee1: Baseline: the supplier’s original written quote for the scope you asked us to negotiate, as recorded in TermLift when we confirm the deal.
termsPage.s15Fee2: Savings: the difference between that baseline and the final signed price for the same scope and the same term. Where the term changes, both sides are compared on an annualised basis.
termsPage.s15Fee3: Not counted as savings unless we agree it in writing for that deal: reductions that come from a smaller scope, fewer seats or units, or removed products and services; credits, free months and other non-cash concessions; and taxes.
termsPage.s15Fee4: Multi-year deals: savings are measured over the committed term confirmed in the deal agreement, not extrapolated beyond it.
termsPage.s15Fee5: The fee is {pct}% of the savings so measured, with a €{min} minimum, invoiced once the contract is signed. If the measured savings are zero, no fee is due.
termsPage.s15Fee6: Because every deal differs, the exact baseline, scope and any agreed exceptions are confirmed in a short written deal agreement (an email is enough) before we start. That deal agreement prevails over this section if they conflict.
termsPage.s16p1: Quotes, contracts and negotiation details often contain confidential commercial information. We use them only to provide the service you asked for, and we share them only with the service providers named in the Privacy Policy and, for the negotiation service, with the supplier to the extent the negotiation needs.
termsPage.s16p2: Our providers process your data under their own terms, and we are not a party to any confidentiality agreement between you and your supplier. Do not upload documents you are not allowed to share with a third-party service. The Security page describes exactly how files and text are handled, including what we have not done yet.
termsPage.s9Item5: Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited under applicable law.

securityPage.title: How we handle your data
securityPage.subtitle: No marketing spin. Here's exactly what happens to your files, where your data goes, and what we're still working on.
securityPage.keyPrinciple: Quote files are read in memory and never stored. The extracted text is kept only until the Negotiation Playbook has been built, the deal closes or 90 days pass; the analysis itself stays until you delete it.
securityPage.uploadTitle: What happens when you upload a file
securityPage.step1Desc: We read the text from your PDF or image. The file is held in memory only.
securityPage.step2Desc: Extracted text is sent to Anthropic's API over TLS for analysis.
securityPage.step3Desc: The original file is discarded when the request ends. It never reaches our database or storage.
securityPage.bottomLineDesc: Your original quote files are never stored. The extracted text is temporary; the analysis is yours until you delete it.
securityPage.inTransitDesc: All data transmitted over TLS (HTTPS). This applies to file uploads, API calls to Anthropic, and all communication with Supabase and Vercel.
securityPage.atRestDesc: Supabase encrypts all stored data with AES-256 encryption. This covers saved deal analyses, account data, and any metadata in our database.
securityPage.fileDeletionDesc1: When you upload a quote, we read its text in memory and discard the file when the request ends. It is never written to a database or to storage. Our application logs record timings, sizes and a few top-level fields such as the vendor name and total, never the document text.
securityPage.fileDeletionDesc2: If you ask TermLift to negotiate for you and attach a document, that file is stored with your consent and removed 30 days after the case closes, or 12 months after upload at the latest.
securityPage.extractedTextDesc1: The text extracted from your quote is stored with the deal so the Negotiation Playbook can be built later without a re-upload. It is not a permanent copy: it is removed once the Playbook is built, when the deal closes, or 90 days after upload at the latest.
securityPage.extractedTextDesc2: What stays is the AI-generated analysis, the structured deal facts (vendor, product, totals, term) and the outcome you record. You can delete any deal at any time.
securityPage.anthropicNoTrain: Anthropic doesn't train on API data
securityPage.aiTrainingDesc1: We use Anthropic's API (Claude) for analysis. Anthropic's API terms explicitly state that data sent through the API is not used to train their models. Your contract text is not being fed into future AI models.
securityPage.aiTrainingDesc2: We also don't use your data to train any models ourselves. Outcomes of closed negotiations may become de-identified benchmark rows (vendor, product, price, term, month of close), reviewed by a person and stripped of any account, deal or document reference. That is a pricing dataset, not training data, and the Privacy Policy describes it.
securityPage.gdprDesc1: We comply with GDPR. You can request access to your data, request deletion, correct inaccurate information, or export your data at any time. Email us and we'll handle it.
securityPage.gdprDesc2: Our database and file storage are hosted in the EU (Supabase, eu-west-1). Processing happens where our providers run: our application on Vercel in the US and AI analysis at Anthropic in the US, under Standard Contractual Clauses.
securityPage.supabaseDesc1: Handles authentication and stores saved deal data. SOC 2 Type II certified. Data encrypted at rest with AES-256. EU-hosted infrastructure.
securityPage.supabaseDesc2: Row Level Security (RLS) is enabled on every table in our database. It enforces account-level access controls at the database layer, so each query only returns the rows that belong to the signed-in account. That is an additional safeguard against cross-account access on top of the checks in the application itself.
securityPage.vercelDesc: Application hosting and edge functions. SOC 2 certified. Provides DDoS protection, automatic HTTPS, and edge caching. Our serverless functions run here, including the file processing and AI analysis endpoints.
securityPage.anthropicDesc: Extracted text is sent to Anthropic's Claude API for contract analysis. Anthropic does not use API data to train models. Data is transmitted over TLS and is not stored by Anthropic beyond their standard API log retention for abuse monitoring.
securityPage.dontSell: Sell your data to anyone — ever
securityPage.dontAdvertise: Use your data for advertising or marketing profiles
securityPage.dontTrain: Train AI models on your uploads or saved data
securityPage.dontShareBeyond: Share data with third parties beyond the services listed above
securityPage.dontAccess: Access your saved deals, except to give support you ask for, to run a negotiation you requested, or to review a closed outcome for the de-identified benchmark described in the Privacy Policy
securityPage.limitationsIntro: In the interest of transparency, here is where TermLift’s security programme stands today:
securityPage.limit1Desc: Our providers (Supabase, Vercel) are. TermLift has not yet completed its own certification.
securityPage.limit2Desc: Third-party testing is planned as the platform scales.
securityPage.limit3Desc: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest and access is restricted, but TermLift can read stored data server-side. That is what lets us provide support and run the negotiation service.
securityPage.limitationsOutro: Security controls and independent testing will continue to mature as the platform scales. If you have specific requirements, ask and we will tell you plainly whether we meet them.
securityPage.questionsIntro: If you have security concerns or questions about how we handle your data, we'd rather you ask than wonder.

what.title: What TermLift does
what.sub: Understanding how TermLift works and what to expect
what.a1: TermLift helps you negotiate better supplier deals. Drop in a quote and the free Quick Analysis gives you a deal score, the key red flags, an estimated savings range and a verdict. The Negotiation Playbook then turns that into ordered asks, fallback positions, leverage and a ready-to-send email. If you would rather not run the negotiation yourself, TermLift can negotiate it for you.
what.q2: What types of quotes can TermLift analyze?
what.a2: Supplier quotes, renewal notices, order forms and contract emails across SaaS, IT and infrastructure, logistics and business services. It works best on B2B quotes with a price, a term and line items. Consumer purchases are out of scope.
what.a3: TermLift is not legal advice, not a guarantee of savings, and not a replacement for reading your contracts. It is a starting point that gives you leverage and structure. Always review the outputs yourself and consult a professional for legal or financial decisions.

upload.title: Uploading quotes
upload.sub: How to get your vendor quotes into TermLift
upload.q1: How do I upload a quote?
upload.a1: You have four options: paste text directly into the text box, upload a PDF file, upload an image (PNG, JPG, or WEBP), or take a screenshot of a pricing page or email. Just drag and drop or click the upload area on the analysis page.
upload.a2: PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, or plain text paste. Maximum file size is 10 MB. For best results with images, make sure the text in the image is clearly readable.
upload.q3: Can I analyze an email from a vendor?
upload.a3: Yes. Just copy the email text and paste it directly into the text input. You can include the full email — subject line, body, pricing tables, terms — and TermLift will analyze all of it.

output.title: Analysis output
output.sub: What you get back and how to use it
output.q1: What is included in Quick Analysis?
output.a1: A deal score from 0 to 100 with its breakdown, the key red flags with their severity and why they matter, an estimated savings range, and a verdict on what is already solid. It does not include the detailed asks, fallback positions, email drafts or negotiation rounds. Those are the Negotiation Playbook.
output.a2: The execution layer for one deal: ordered negotiation asks with quantified impact, fallback positions, your leverage, what you can offer in return, must-have versus nice-to-have savings, and a ready-to-send negotiation email in the tone that fits the relationship. It also covers every follow-up round on that deal.
output.a3: Yes. Once a deal has its Playbook, upload or paste the vendor’s reply as a new round. TermLift records their offer, explains what changed against the previous position and prepares your counter. Rounds are unlimited on that deal.
output.a4: No. AI can miss details, misinterpret terms, or make errors. TermLift is a starting point for negotiation, not the final word. Always review the outputs against your original documents before acting on them. If something looks off, it probably is. Trust your judgment.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.sub: How we handle your documents and data
privacy.q1: Are my uploaded quote files stored?
privacy.a1: No. Quote files are read in memory and discarded when the request ends. The text extracted from them stays with the deal only until the Playbook has been built, the deal closes or 90 days pass. The analysis and the structured deal facts stay until you delete the deal.
privacy.a2: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, database access is enforced per account with Row Level Security, and your documents are never used to train AI models. Anthropic processes the extracted text under its API terms and does not train on it. The Security page lists exactly what we do and what we have not done yet.
privacy.q3: What if I upload confidential documents?
privacy.a3: Treat TermLift like any cloud-based tool. Do not upload documents you are contractually prohibited from sharing with third-party services. Your text is sent to Anthropic’s API for processing. See our Privacy Policy and Terms for full details.

billing.title: Account & pricing
billing.sub: What it costs and how to manage your account
billing.a1: Yes. No card, no trial clock. Try one quote without signing up. Create a free account for up to {limit} Quick Analyses, saved deals and the Negotiation Playbook.
billing.q2: How many free Quick Analyses do I get?
billing.a2: One without an account on the try page, and up to {limit} with a free account. Playbooks, emails and rounds on your existing deals never count against that number.
billing.q3: What does the Negotiation Playbook cost? Is it per deal?
billing.a3: {price}, one time, per deal. It covers everything on that deal: the asks, fallbacks, leverage, the email and every follow-up round. There is no subscription.
billing.q4: What happens after the early-access period?
billing.a4: Until {date} every Playbook is free. After that, the first Playbook on any account stays free and each further one is {price} per deal. Anything you built during early access stays yours.
billing.a5: You submit the deal with your objective, alternatives, competing quotes, seats or usage and any relationship context. A negotiator reviews it and confirms the scope with you, then runs the back-and-forth with the supplier. You follow every status change in the app and approve the outcome.
billing.q6: How is the {pct}% success fee calculated, and what are verified savings?
billing.a6: The fee is {pct}% of verified savings, with a €{min} minimum, invoiced once the contract is signed. Verified savings are the documented difference between the supplier’s original written quote and the final signed price for the same scope and term. Reductions from a smaller scope, fewer seats or removed items, credits and non-cash concessions, and taxes are not counted unless agreed in writing. No savings, no fee.
billing.q7: Does TermLift contact vendors without my approval?
billing.a7: No. We only contact the supplier after you have submitted a negotiation request and confirmed the scope with us. Nothing is agreed without your explicit approval, and you sign the contract yourself. TermLift never signs for you or binds you.
billing.a8: Yes. Go to Settings and choose “Delete account”. Your saved deals, analysis history and account details are removed immediately. This cannot be undone.

trouble.title: Troubleshooting
trouble.sub: Common issues and how to fix them
trouble.a1: Try running it again. If it keeps failing, the document may be too long or in an unsupported format. Try pasting just the key sections as plain text instead. If the problem persists, email hello@termlift.com and we'll help.
trouble.q2: The analysis doesn't match my document
trouble.a2: AI can misinterpret content, especially from images or complex PDFs with tables and fine print. For better results, try pasting the key sections as plain text instead of uploading a file. If the analysis is way off, let us know at hello@termlift.com so we can improve.

privacy.a1: Yes. Quote files are read in memory and never stored. The extracted text stays with the deal only until the Negotiation Playbook has been built, the deal closes, or 90 days pass; the analysis itself stays until you delete the deal. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. Your documents are never used for AI training.
privacy.a4: Yes. Go to your profile settings and choose 'Delete account.' Your account, saved deals, analysis history and any document you uploaded for the negotiation service are removed immediately. De-identified benchmark rows built from closed deals carry no link to your account and remain. This cannot be undone.
